local data={
	-----Sanity-----
	["Sanity"]={name="Sanity", tier=6, use="A mental concept essential for sustaining one's ego and supporting the planning and execution of various operations.", desc="██████. ██████, ██████. ██████.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Item Consumption: Sanity Syrup"},
	-----Sanity Extractor-----
	["Sanity Extractor"]={name="Sanity Extractor", tier=4, use="Fill this with Sanity to convert it into Sanity Essence.", desc="A special auto-extractor. \"Your keen senses shall be fused with your desires to explore this world, and create medicinal sanity supplements that you can hold in reserve.\"", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
	-----Sanity Recovery Items Standard-----
	["LTO Sanity Syrup"]={name="LTO Sanity Syrup", tier=4, use="Use this to recover Sanity. This item also has an expiration date.", desc="A pharmaceutical agent capable of restoring sanity. Consider doubling your intake if you see double while reading these instructions.", obtain="Reward: Events"},
	["Emergency Sanity Sample"]={name="Emergency Sanity Sample", tier=4, use="Use this to recover 10 Sanity. This item also has an expiration date.", desc="A small dose of Sanity syrup sample contained within an emergency-use package. Use this item on time and avoid unnecessary stockpiling to avoid expiration.", obtain="Reward: Events"},
	["Emergency Sanity Booster"]={name="Emergency Sanity Booster", tier=4, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity. This item also has an expiration date.", desc="A moderate dose of Sanity syrup contained with an emergency-use package. The developer seemed to have acquired a secret formula from some strange documents that multiplied the amount of sugar within this specific preparation.", obtain="Reward: Daily Missions, Reward: Protocol Pass, Daily Rewards: Monthly Pass"},
	["Emergency Sanity Concentrate"]={name="Emergency Sanity Concentrate", tier=4, use="Use this to recover 100 Sanity. This item also has an expiration date.", desc="A large dose of Sanity syrup contained with an emergency-use package. Its effects are immediate. A list of side-effects, including severe insomnia, have been provided in the user's manual. Good luck!", obtain="Reward: Events"},
	-----Sanity Recovery Special-----
	["Sanity Syrup"]={name="Sanity Syrup", tier=4, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="A pharmaceutical agent capable of restoring sanity. Consider doubling your intake if you're seeing double when reading these instructions.", obtain="Submit Aurylene at TP Points"},
	["Sanity Essence"]={name="Sanity Essence", tier=4, use="Use this to recover 120 Sanity.", desc="A very special Sanity potion. There is no need to panic if you experience throat swelling, throat pain, or abdominal discomfort after use. Just drink some warm water to alleviate the said symptoms.", obtain=""},
	["Seasalt Ice Cream"]={name="Seasalt Ice Cream", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="Ice cream with a dash of seasalt to bring out its sweetness. This is one of Laevatain's most preferred flavors, of which there are quite a few.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
	["Strawberry Crepe"]={name="Strawberry Crepe", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="A crepe with a generous load of stuffing. Yvonne also gave it some fondant accessories in the likeness of Frost-e-Bytee and Tink-a-Bella.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
	["Chestnut Honey"]={name="Chestnut Honey", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="Sweet and refreshing. Gilberta thinks you might have a liking for honey of chestnut flowers, so she bought some from a chestnut orchard during her messenger work.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
    ["Dried Fin"]={name="Dried Fin", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="Meticulously sun dried and processed with many grueling steps that take nearly two months. The snack on its own gives off the savory sweet taste of fins when chewed. Things that start off bitter and hard often reach a happy conclusion. This is the insight that Tangtang wants to share with you.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
    ["Apple Slices"]={name="Apple Slices", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="Rossi personally sliced these apples herself to delicious bite-sizes. It does not matter if the apples were hanging from a wild tree or being sold at a market stall. She can always identify the sweetest one.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
	["Wholly-Braised Sprout (can)"]={name="Wholly-Braised Sprout (can)", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="Zhuang Fangyi's favorite braised sprouts, made from an entire bamboo sprout. Extremely therapeutic for those exhausted by the stress of heavy overtime.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
	["Lungclaw Ultra-E"]={name="Lungclaw Ultra-E", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="Mi Fu's go-to functional drink. It can quickly get someone back to being \"fully pumped\" without excessive agitation or stimulation. Mi Fu hopes you can remain energized while you perform your exhausting tasks.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
	["Devil's Licorice Drops"]={name="Devil's Licorice Drops", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="Devil's Licorice Drops from Camille. Most people describe the experience of eating these strange snacks as \"hosting a boxing match in the mouth\", but Camille seems to enjoy it a lot.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
	["Osmanthus Rice Cake"]={name="Osmanthus Rice Cake", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="Osmanthus Rice Cake from Arcane. Sweet but not cloyingly so. This dessert brings back tastes from her childhood of memories. With you, she's willing to share moments where she relaxed and enjoyed the company of friends.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
	["Handmade Star Candy"]={name="Handmade Star Candy", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="Star candy that Liino made herself. They look small and cute, and taste just as good as the expensive stuff sold at La Fantoma candy shops.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
	["Samivegric Salted Fin"]={name="Samivegric Salted Fin", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="Specialty salted fin from Samivegr. These salted fins taste quite unique but if properly prepared and cooked, they offer an unparalleled taste of savory flavors.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
	["Pine Soot Ink Stick"]={name="Pine Soot Ink Stick", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="An ink stick created with a mix of various herbs. It exudes a mild, elegant herbal fragrance on par with the finest incense. The aroma alone is quite invigorating to the mind. You can also nibble on a tiny piece to purge mental ailments and unclean spirits.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
	["Nuli Cake"]={name="Nuli Cake", tier=5, use="Use this to recover 40 Sanity.", desc="A box of small cakes that resemble Argent Flow's close companion. Every piece shows a different temperament. Some look happy, while others look haughty. The box is quite an attractive display of fine baking techniques and clever designs galloping side by side.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
